title: A shrinking PC market and AI-led discovery mean we must win on value
summary: Asus sees the 2027 PC market shrinking 10-15% on memory costs; tablet shipments fell 23% in Q3 (Omdia). Amazon took Alexa shopping to 15 countries; OpenAI launched ChatGPT Wallet; JD.com seeks Ceconomy. Amex sees 14-year-high small-business holiday spend.

points.headline: Memory costs are shrinking PC and tablet demand into 2027
points.detail: Asus expects the 2027 PC market down 10-15%, notebooks stay weak through Q2 2027 and Q3 tablet shipments fell 23%. We should plan promo depth, mix and financing for a smaller, price-led market.

points.headline: AI shopping assistants and agent payments are going mainstream
points.detail: Amazon took Alexa for Shopping to 15 countries and OpenAI launched ChatGPT Wallet for agent checkout. We should make our listings, content and checkout ready for agent-driven discovery and orders.

points.headline: Amazon and JD.com are reshaping where electronics buyers start
points.detail: Amazon plans to catalog every product online, even items it does not stock, and JD.com seeks to lead European electronics retail via Ceconomy. We should watch channel terms and keep our product data accurate.

points.headline: Small businesses are spending while consumers hunt for value
points.detail: Amex projects a 14-year high in small-business holiday spending, while NRF finds affordability shapes holiday plans. We should push business bundles and financing and test value-led consumer offers.
